title: jmap-chat-js: fetchSession sends no Authorization; no push; plain http only for localhost/127.0.0.1
description: From A4 (2026-11-16) against jmap-chat-js 9934223: (1) src/lib/jmap/session.ts:71,91 fetchSession takes no credentials, so an authenticated Session (RFC 8620 §2) answers 401; client.ts itself works. (2) Nothing reads eventSourceUrl; browser EventSource cannot send Authorization, so push needs a fetch-based stream. (3) session.ts:84-86,113-115 allow plain http only for localhost and 127.0.0.1, refusing [::1]. jmap-chat-js is Mark's repo; raise with its session/owner. mimid's acceptance harness wraps fetch to add the token (tools/acceptance/jmap-chat-js).
notes: Mark 2026-11-19: fix all three in jmap-chat-js (his repo), push to MarkAtwood/project-jmap-chat-js.
close_reason: Fixed in jmap-chat-js 7789c2b (pushed 2026-11-19, Mark's OK); harness updated in c41fd62.
